What changed in this PR Adds source-aware gather planning and explicit catalog preparation as a staged migration from legacy Gutenberg consumers. **Changes:** - Validates collection selections before **<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the catalog prefix in nested command help**

When a user runs `lcats catalog setup --help` (similarly for `status`, `refresh`, and `rebuild`), these subcommand parsers retain the `prog` value assigned when the standalone parent parser was constructed, so argparse prints usage such as `usage: cli.py setup ...` rather than `usage: lcats catalog setup ...`. Construct the nested parsers with the final catalog program name, or build them directly on `catalog_parser`, so the new command's help shows a valid invocation.
